subject: Decision: v1 ships head attributes only
body:
Team,

Decision from this morning's sync: v1 scope is head attributes only. The synonym-pooling experiments recovered maybe a quarter of the tail vocabulary at acceptable precision, and chasing the rest puts the launch review date at risk.

What this means concretely:
- Next week's reserved compute goes entirely to the head-attribute retraining sweep at production embedding scale.
- Tail attribute coverage moves to the Q3 OKR list; I'll get it in before the 6/26 lock.
- Nadia, adding us to the LRB agenda for the first slot after the sweep completes.

Good, pragmatic call from Katya and Yara here - the coverage analysis made this easy.

Anders
